notice.headingAr: إعلام حول معالجة المعطيات ذات الطابع الشخصي
notice.textFr: Les informations de votre candidature (identité, coordonnées, CV et pièces jointes, appréciations des entretiens) sont enregistrées par {{company}} pour la gestion de ce recrutement. Elles ne sont consultées que par le service des ressources humaines et les personnes chargées des entretiens. Si la candidature n'est pas retenue, elles sont effacées {{months}} mois après la décision. En cas d'embauche, elles sont versées au dossier du personnel. Vous pouvez demander à les consulter, à les faire rectifier ou effacer auprès du service des ressources humaines (loi n° 18-07 du 10 juin 2018).
notice.textAr: تُسجَّل معلومات ملف الترشح (الهوية، بيانات الاتصال، السيرة الذاتية والوثائق المرفقة، تقييمات المقابلات) من طرف {{company}} لغرض تسيير عملية التوظيف هذه. لا يطّلع عليها إلا مصلحة الموارد البشرية وأعضاء لجنة المقابلة. في حال عدم قبول الترشح، تُحذف هذه المعلومات بعد {{months}} شهرا من تاريخ القرار. وفي حال التوظيف، تُحفظ ضمن ملف المستخدَمين. يمكن طلب الاطلاع عليها أو تصحيحها أو حذفها لدى مصلحة الموارد البشرية (القانون رقم 18-07 المؤرخ في 10 يونيو 2018).

rubriques.codeHint: The item’s code in the payroll software (1 to 20 characters: letters without accents, digits, “_”, “.”, “-”).
rubriques.unitFixed: The unit of a computed item follows its source.
rubriques.amountHint: Amounts are seen and typed only by people with access to salaries.

format.intro: The payroll file is a text file to import into the payroll software. Set it up the way that software expects.

layouts.per_line: One line per employee and pay item
layouts.per_employee: One line per employee, one column per pay item

layoutHints.per_employee: The columns of the active pay items follow the chosen columns, in the items’ order.

format.encodingHint: Windows programs often expect Windows-1252; a character it does not know becomes “?”.

columnsHint.per_line: The matricule, the pay item and the value are required; at most {{max}} columns.
columnsHint.per_employee: The matricule is required; at most {{max}} columns before the pay item columns.

format.rubriqueColumns: + one column per active pay item (header = export code)

columnsProblem.invalid: This list of columns is not valid for this layout.
columnsProblem.missing_rubrique_value: The pay item and the value are required.

format.previewHint: The first 5 lines with the saved settings (this month’s variables, or example lines).
format.previewError: The preview could not be loaded.

calendar.regularizationMonths: Closed months recomputed (adjustments from a closed month)

hints.cutoffDay: A month can be closed from this day ({{min}} to {{max}}). Anything that changes a closed month afterwards comes back as an adjustment in the next month.
hints.regularizationMonths: Number of closed months checked on each computation ({{min}} to {{max}}; 0 = no adjustments).
hints.overtimeMinMinutes: A shorter excess on a working day is not counted ({{min}} to {{max}} minutes).

personal.loadError: Could not load the change requests.

emergency.clearHint: Leave the three fields empty to keep no emergency contact.

errors.phone: Invalid number: 8 to 20 digits, « + » and spaces allowed.
errors.future: The date cannot be in the future.
errors.emergencyIncomplete: Enter the name, relationship and phone, or leave all three empty.

requests.title: Change requests
requests.intro: Requests of the employees in your scope. Those waiting for your decision are in « My tasks ».

diff.caption: Requested changes
diff.changedSince: Changed since the request: the current values are no longer those the employee saw. Approving still applies the requested values.
diff.ribMasked: RIB masked: only holders of the bank-details permission see it in full.

task.title: Change request
task.approveHint: Approving applies the change and files the supporting documents in the employee file. Rejecting needs a comment, which the employee will see.
task.approveHintNote: Approving marks the report as handled: nothing is changed. Correct the identity from the « Identity » tab.
task.approveHintBank: Approving replaces the RIB; a security e-mail is sent to the employee.

problems.applyFailed: The change for {{name}} could not be applied: the requested values are no longer valid. Reject the request with a comment.
problems.employmentEnded: The request of {{name}} can no longer be applied: the employment has ended.

profile.title: My profile
profile.intro: Your personal details. Some changes apply at once; the others are approved by HR.
profile.notLinked: Your account is not linked to a current employment, so your profile is not available. Contact HR if this is a mistake.

identity.title: Identity
identity.name: Name
identity.readOnly: HR changes these details from official papers.
identity.noteHint: Describe the error and the right value (at most {{max}} characters). You may attach a document.

mode.approval: This change will be sent to HR for approval.
mode.familyApproval: This change will be sent to HR for approval. A change of status or children needs a supporting document.
mode.bankApproval: A new RIB is approved by central HR, with a RIB attached. An e-mail will confirm the change.
mode.identityNote: Your message goes to HR, who will correct the details from official papers.

form.commentHint: Optional, read by HR (at most 500 characters).

errors.phone: Invalid number: 8 to 20 digits, "+" and spaces allowed.
errors.future: The date cannot be in the future.

files.label: Supporting documents
files.hint: At most {{count}} files (PDF, JPEG or PNG, {{max}} each).
files.hintFamily: Family booklet, marriage certificate, birth certificate…
files.required: Attach at least one supporting document.

feedback.noteSent: Your report was sent to HR.

problems.pending: A request is already pending for this section.
problems.unchanged: Nothing changed: the values are the same.
problems.ended: Your employment has ended: changes can no longer be requested.
problems.notLinked: Your account is no longer linked to a current employment.
problems.notCancellable: This request can no longer be cancelled (it was already handled).

requests.title: My requests
requests.filePurged: file erased or moved to the employee file

settings.title: Profile change requests
settings.intro: Choose, for each section, whether employees’ changes apply at once or go through HR.
settings.alwaysApproval: Bank details and error reports always go through HR.
settings.retention: Keep files of rejected or cancelled requests (days)
settings.retentionError: Enter a whole number of days between {{min}} and {{max}}.
